_comment: One source of truth for week 8's rubric. The grader scores from this file, the homework's grading table is copied from it, and you can read it. `suite` says which test run scores an item — 'checks' is `dotnet test Project.Checks` (canonical, replaced wholesale by the grader), 'tests' is `dotnet test Project.Tests` (the student's OWN suite, run as-is and never replaced). NEW this week: the student's dictated fact name carries the WEEK rather than a check number, because that suite is permanent and grows every week — two facts called Check5_something in one file is how the week-7 scheme would have broken. There is no 'both' item this week, which is what lets my checks keep the CheckN_ numbering the task headings depend on. The graded repo is the PROJECT repo (D1b); the coursework repo is cloned only for the hygiene sweep.

Check1_WeeksFourToSevenStillHold.label: Weeks 4-7 still hold — Topic, no public fields, All() copies, Find and Remove behave, IListed kept by record and registry, Everything() intact, and Add still refuses a duplicate

Check2_TheRegistryWritesItselfDown.label: Save(string path) writes a file at the path it was handed, with the records in it

Check3_TheRegistrySurvivesARestart.label: Load(string path) fills a fresh registry back up — count and Find both — and a missing file is a first run, not a crash

Check4_ARecordKeepsItsOwnFacts.label: A record's own sealed facts survive the round trip — the private-set trap, closed

Week8_TheRegistrySurvivesARestart.label: Your test: the registry is still there after a restart — written by you, green in your own suite

repoReachable.label: Public project repo exists at the URL you submitted, and clones

programRuns.label: The program builds and runs without crashing — even when fed nothing but Enter

gitignoreClean.label: bin/ and obj/ tracked in NEITHER repo — the .gitignore holding, in both places

commits.label: 3+ commits on THIS week's branch 👀 (meaningful messages are a judgment call)

mergedPr.label: A merge commit on main — this week's branch → pull request → merge
